mapper.select: select sum(ifnull(a.tdy_o_c_amt,0)) - sum(ifnull(a.tdy_o_d_amt,0)) -(sum(ifnull(a.tdy_o_co_c_amt,0)) - sum(ifnull(a.tdy_o_co_d_amt,0))) from BOK_BALANCE a where a.bookset_id = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.balance_date = #{balanceDate,jdbcType=DATE} and a.subject_no not in ('6101', '6112') and a.subject_no like '6%' and length(IFNULL(a.subject_no,'')) = 4

select sum(IFNULL(a.tdy_o_c_amt,0)) - sum(IFNULL(a.tdy_o_d_amt,0)) -(sum(IFNULL(a.tdy_o_co_c_amt,0)) - sum(IFNULL(a.tdy_o_co_d_amt,0))) from BOK_BALANCE a where a.bookset_id = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.balance_date = #{balanceDate,jdbcType=DATE} and a.subject_no in ('6101', '6112')

select sum(IFNULL(a.O_C_AMT,0)) - sum(IFNULL(a.O_D_AMT,0)) from BOK_BALANCE a where a.bookset_id = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.balance_date = #{balanceDate,jdbcType=DATE} and a.subject_no in ('4103', '4104')

SELECT CASE WHEN F.PUBLISH_TYPE=#{publistType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN if(RATE_TYPE='01',RATE,(IFNULL(MI.INT_RATE, 0) * F.COEFFICIENT + F.SPREAD_RATE)*(1)/365) ELSE if(RATE_TYPE='01',RATE,(IFNULL(F.RATE_LOWER, 0) * F.COEFFICIENT + F.SPREAD_RATE)*(1)/365) END stMance , case when F.PUBLISH_TYPE=#{publistType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN (IFNULL(MI.INT_RATE*F.COEFFICIENT,0)+IFNULL(F.SPREAD_RATE,0))*100 ELSE IFNULL(F.RATE_LOWER,0)*100 END rateBenchmark , case when F.PUBLISH_TYPE=#{publistType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} then if(RATE_TYPE='01',concat_ws('',L.ITEM_VALUE,cast(RATE*100 as decimal(6,2)),'%'), concat_ws('',S.ITEM_VALUE,'(', cast(IFNULL(MI.INT_RATE*F.COEFFICIENT,0)*100 as decimal(6,2)),'%)','+','(', cast(IFNULL(F.SPREAD_RATE*100,0) as decimal(6,2)),'%),即?(',cast((IFNULL(MI.INT_RATE*F.COEFFICIENT,0)*100+IFNULL(F.SPREAD_RATE,0)*100) as decimal(6,2)),'%)')) else concat_ws('',S.ITEM_VALUE,'([',cast(IFNULL(F.RATE_LIMIT,0)*100 as decimal(6,2)),'%','-',cast(IFNULL(F.RATE_LOWER,0)*100 as decimal(6,2)),'%])','+','(', cast(IFNULL(F.RATE_LIMIT*100,0) as decimal(6,2)),'%),即?([',cast((IFNULL(F.RATE_LIMIT,0)+IFNULL(F.SPREAD_RATE,0))*100 as decimal(6,2)),'-', cast((IFNULL(F.RATE_LOWER,0)+IFNULL(F.SPREAD_RATE,0))*100 as decimal(6,2)),'%])') end stDetail
FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO F LEFT JOIN MST_INT_RATE_INFO MI ON F.INDEX_ID=MI.INT_RATE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST L ON F.RATE_TYPE = L.ITEM_CODE AND L.DICT_CODE='RATE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST S ON F.INDEX_ID = S.item_code AND S.DICT_CODE='SECRATE_DATA'
WHERE F.BASE_RULE_TYPE=#{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and F.FINPROD_ID =#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND F.EFF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EFF_DATE <= #{bookDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) AND (MI.EFF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(MS.EFF_DATE) FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO MS WHERE MS.EFF_DATE <= #{valueDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND MS.INT_RATE_ID = F.INDEX_ID )or MI.EFF_DATE is null )
